messages:
ida: quick ping — PR #523 added a function-calling example that returns a union (array | object | null). our SDK schema generator choked on the union. can someone triage?

pete: which doc example?

ida: examples/tool-calls.md -> 'export_settings' section. model produced `{\"settings\": null}` in one run and `{\"settings\": {\"theme\": \"dark\"}}` in another. the schema currently uses `oneOf` but the snippets don't show the union types clearly.

sara: ah, generator doesn't like mixing `array` and `object` in the same union without explicit discriminator. we should prefer `anyOf` with clear examples and show parse_fallback patterns.

michael: SDK side: TS types come out as `any` in that case. i'd rather emit a union type `Setting[] | SettingObject | null` in docs snippets so users see the shape. will adjust generator template.

ida: could we also add a tiny note in docs about normalizing at parse time? e.g. show `const settings = Array.isArray(parsed.settings) ? parsed.settings : parsed.settings ? [parsed.settings] : [];` That helps clients adapt.

pete: good idea. also add a short JSON Schema example using `anyOf: [{type: \"array\", items: {...}}, {type: \"object\"}, {type: \"null\"}]` so it validates both outputs.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview failed for PR #523 — example-union-check. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/523/build/4

sara: i'll update the example to use `anyOf` and add the parse normalizer snippet inline. michael — can you make the TS snippet clearer in the docs (avoid `any`)?

michael: yes — will open SDK PR for improved typing + unit test simulating both shapes. PR ETA today.

ida: thanks. after SDK PR lands i'll rerun local docs validation. plan: sara edits -> michael PR -> local parse tests -> merge. i'll add a migration note under "Structured output tips" explaining the union handling pattern.

sara: added the normalizer and schema patch in draft PR #525. linking unit test examples.

michael: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/812 — replaces `any` with explicit unions and adds tests.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview for PR #525 passed (schema + examples). remaining blocker: sdk merge.

ida: once sdk merge is green i'll update the CHANGELOG and close issue #541. thanks all :white_check_mark:
